name: Skillet Sirloin Steak with Pan Gravy
ingredients_verbatim: 2 lbs. top sirloin steak, strip steak, or ribeye
2-3 drops gravy master or kitchen bouquet (optional)
why: Dead-center of the band on the source's own numbers: 490 cal / 8 g carb / 53 g protein per serving. Whole-muscle top sirloin (board: sirloin-steak) seared then sliced, plus a low-carb pan gravy (butter/flour/beef-broth) - batch-scalable to 14 with weigh-and-divide, no rice/potato/pasta base. Cleanly distinct from every accepted beef slug (steak bites w/ zucchini, flank parmesan, flank rolls, fajita skillet). Carries a few genuinely-absent board items (dry white wine, bouillon cube, gravy master) - good pricer-lane fuel.
confidence: high - read published nutrition directly from recipe card
